title: 1 Kings 18:39-40 — The people declare "The LORD, He is God"; prophets of Baal seized
summary: The text of 1 Kings 18:39-40: seeing the fire, all the people fall on their faces and say "The LORD, He is God" twice; Elijah then orders the prophets of Baal seized and brings them down to the brook Kishon and slays them there. The names LORD, God and Elijah are coloured.

text.text: 39 When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces; and they said, “The LORD, He is God; the LORD, He is God.”
40 Then Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal; do not let one of them escape.” So they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

events: slaying of the prophets of Baal
